cardTitle: ML Ensemble for Time Series Classification
cardDesc: 133-feature XGBoost pipeline for 3-class financial time series classification with temporal validation.
label: Machine Learning
title: ML Ensemble for Time Series Classification
overview: End-to-end ML pipeline for classifying financial time series into 3 market regimes. Engineered 133 features from multi-modal data sources including technical indicators, fundamental data, and macroeconomic signals. XGBoost model achieved 67.4% accuracy with strict temporal validation to prevent data leakage.
details: Volatility-adjusted classification scheme and momentum/lag indicator engineering
Multi-modal ingestion: Yahoo Finance and Alpha Vantage APIs for technical, fundamental, macro data
Strict temporal train/test split to prevent lookahead bias in validation
Modular pipeline architecture for swappable feature sets and model backends
